title: MyAgentWebsite
description: SaaS platform for real estate agents to create professional websites without technical knowledge.
details: A multi-tenant 'Shopify for Real Estate Agents' platform that lets agents and small agencies launch their own branded websites without a developer. Features a unified admin backoffice for managing listings, blog posts, testimonials, and newsletters. Each agent gets their own branded domain with white-label capabilities. Built on a Rails API with multiple React frontends (customer site, admin dashboard, and marketing site), all deployed on Railway and Vercel.

title: Dois Agentes
description: An AI assistant for Portuguese real estate agents that keeps track of contacts, deals and follow-ups, and drafts the next step.
details: Dois Agentes is an assistant for real estate agents in Portugal. It is sold alongside MyAgentWebsite and can inherit its listings. Work reaches it when a message or a synced listing arrives, when a scheduled job runs, or when the agent asks it something. It keeps the agent's contacts, deals, visit sheets and valuations, tracks each deal through a numbered service checklist, and lets the agent consult specialists that cite the sources they used. It drafts, and the agent decides what goes out. Built as a single Rails 8 app with Hotwire and Solid Queue on Railway, with Claude models called through OpenRouter.

title: UpSpeech
description: Multi-tenant SaaS platform for speech-language pathologists focused on stuttering therapy.
details: A multi-tenant SaaS platform that helps speech-language pathologists (SLPs) deliver stuttering therapy. I built the web platform end-to-end — session management, patient progress tracking, multi-tenancy, authentication, and deployment infrastructure — with a Rails 8 API backing a React + TypeScript frontend. Currently extending the platform with a React Native mobile companion for clinicians and patients on the go.

title: Therapy Resources
description: Tool for therapists and psychologists to generate custom consultation resources and printable games, with PDF export.
details: A tool for therapists and psychologists to create custom games and printable resources for use in consultations. Features a canvas-based visual editor built on Konva, AI-generated illustrations that match each therapist's visual style, PDF export via @react-pdf for print-ready outputs, QR code generation for digital/physical crossovers, and multilingual support via next-intl. Separate product from UpSpeech — different market, different workflow.

title: KidShare
description: Co-parenting app for separated parents: shared expenses, the custody calendar and messages in one place.
details: KidShare gives two households one record of the kids' lives. A parent logs a cost and picks the split, and KidShare keeps a running statement of who owes whom, with recurring expenses, monthly summaries and recorded payments. The custody calendar shows who has the kids each day and when the next handover is. Messages, family rules and documents live next to the money. Built with React 19 on a Convex backend, installable as a PWA with push notifications, and deployed on Vercel.

title: Basketball Stats App
description: Full-stack basketball statistics tracking with real-time game scoring, shot charts, and cross-platform mobile support.
details: A basketball statistics platform with live game scoring, visual shot charts with heatmaps and zone analysis, player comparisons with radar charts, and automatic league standings. Built as a monorepo with shared TypeScript types, it includes both a React web app and a React Native mobile app (iOS/Android) powered by a Convex serverless backend for real-time updates.

title: Basketball Video Analyzer
description: Desktop app for basketball coaches to cut, categorize, and organize video clips for team scouting.
details: A cross-platform desktop application (Windows, macOS, Linux) built for basketball coaches and analysts. Allows cutting specific plays from game footage, organizing clips with hierarchical categories, and saving category structures as reusable presets across projects. Features include time-based search, automatic clip organization, and export capabilities for sharing with teams and players. Includes auto-update functionality.

title: Delivered Photos
description: Multi-tenant SaaS for photographers to deliver client galleries, collect proof selections, and sell prints.
details: A client proofing and delivery platform for photographers. Fast, beautiful galleries where clients select favorites, download high-res files, and order prints. Built as a pnpm monorepo with a Convex backend and two React + Vite apps — a photographer dashboard and the client-facing gallery — sharing auth and schema. Originals are stored in S3 with presigned URLs; payments run through Dodo. Competing with Pixieset and ShootProof, with a focus on speed and modern UX.

title: CoinSprout
description: Personal finance tracker for individuals and couples, with AI-powered bank statement parsing.
details: A personal finance tracker built for individuals and couples. Features a contextual dashboard, net-worth tracking, AI-powered parsing of bank statements (CSV/TSV/PDF/images) via OpenAI GPT-4o, split expenses and reimbursements, recurring transactions, per-category budgets and savings goals, and rich reporting (category breakdown, monthly income-vs-expenses, 90-day activity heatmap, month-over-month comparison, 3-month rolling trends). Light/dark mode.

title: Cadence Studio
description: A one-person AI content studio where specialist agents draft in your voice and nothing publishes until you approve it.
details: Cadence runs a small team of specialist agents that write in your voice on a schedule you set. Drafts land in one review queue, and each draft sits next to one you already approved so you can compare the voice side by side. Every draft is checked against 16 rules, including a 27-word vocabulary watchlist, and the queue marks what they catch, such as em-dash asides, antithesis, hedge openers and resolution closers. Built with React 19, TanStack Router and Convex, using the Vercel AI SDK across Claude, Gemini and OpenAI, fal.ai for images, and Bluesky as the first publishing channel. It is in private beta.

title: Analytics Hub
description: Centralized analytics dashboard aggregating metrics from 10+ sources across my projects, with weekly HTML digest emails.
details: A centralized analytics dashboard that pulls metrics from 10+ sources — GA4, Search Console, Cloudflare, Vercel, Railway, GitHub, Bing, Lighthouse, and AhaSend — across all my personal projects. Runs scheduled Convex crons to sync data, exposes a Next.js dashboard to explore trends, and ships a weekly HTML digest email summarising traffic, deploys, and performance. Built to stop bouncing between dashboards.

title: ProTasca
description: Multi-tenant website builder for restaurants — menus, reservations, online ordering, and local SEO, commission-free.
details: A multi-tenant website builder for restaurants. Auto-populates sites from TheFork, Zomato, and Google Business; provides menu management, online ordering, reservations, and local SEO — all commission-free. Same multi-tenant pattern as the real-estate platform: Rails API, React frontend for the public site, React backoffice for owners, React promo site.

title: FPB Calendar
description: Tool to fetch team's basketball games and sync them to Google Calendar, with its own calendar.
details: This tool fetches games from the Portuguese Basketball Federation and adds them to a shared Google Calendar. It also allows sharing among teams and uses OAuth to authenticate securely with Google.

title: IMKAUFMANN
description: A website for a photographer to manage and showcase his portfolio, with custom layout controls.
details: This project was designed for an up-and-coming photographer to manage and publish his work. Admins can customize how galleries are presented (carousel, grid, etc), and upload images via Cloudinary using CarrierWave. It features a full custom CMS and dynamic content structure. Built with Rails and includes React-based components for preview/editing functionality.

title: Jovens Futuro
description: Blog platform for young adults to share their passions with SEO optimization and social media previews.
details: Jovens Futuro is a publishing platform for young adults. Writers can create rich blog posts using a WYSIWYG editor. Each article has optimized metadata, SEO-friendly URLs, and Open Graph preview images dynamically generated via Cloudinary. Built with Rails and React, with an admin backend for moderation.

title: Portfolio Site
description: My personal site built with SvelteKit and TailwindCSS, showcasing projects, experience and contact info.
details: This site was built with SvelteKit and TailwindCSS. It features animated transitions, project showcase pages, JSON-powered content, and a no-backend contact form using Formspree. It reflects my attention to clean UX and minimalist design.

title: AOC Ruby (aoc_rb)
description: Ruby toolkit to automate Advent of Code puzzles. Contributed improvements and bug fixes.
details: This toolkit sets up and manages daily Advent of Code challenges. I contributed bug fixes and quality-of-life improvements after using it in my own workflow. It's a fun CLI tool that makes AOC coding challenges smoother and more structured.
